sentences.text: Ayn Rand -LRB- -LSB- ˈaɪn_ˈrænd -RSB- born Alisa Zinov ` yevna Rosenbaum , Али́са Зино́вьевна Розенба́ум -- March 6 , 1982 -RRB- was a Russian-American novelist , philosopher , playwright , and screenwriter .	novelist	novelist

She is known for her two best-selling novels , The Fountainhead and Atlas Shrugged , and for developing a philosophical system she called Objectivism .	The Fountainhead	The Fountainhead	Atlas Shrugged	Atlas Shrugged	Objectivism	Objectivism (Ayn Rand)
Educated in Russia , she moved to the United States in 1926 .
She had a play produced on Broadway in 1935 -- 1936 .	Broadway	Broadway theatre
After two early novels that were initially unsuccessful in America , she achieved fame with her 1943 novel , The Fountainhead .	The Fountainhead	The Fountainhead
In 1957 , Rand published her best-known work , the novel Atlas Shrugged .	Atlas Shrugged	Atlas Shrugged
Afterward , she turned to non-fiction to promote her philosophy , publishing her own magazines and releasing several collections of essays until her death in 1982 .
Rand advocated reason as the only means of acquiring knowledge , and rejected faith and religion .	reason	reason	knowledge	knowledge
She supported rational and ethical egoism , and rejected altruism .	rational	rational egoism	ethical egoism	ethical egoism	altruism	Altruism (ethics)

In politics , she condemned the initiation of force as immoral , and opposed collectivism and statism as well as anarchism , and instead supported laissez-faire capitalism , which she defined as the system based on recognizing individual rights .	initiation of force	initiation of force	collectivism	collectivism	statism	statism	anarchism	anarchism	laissez-faire	laissez-faire	capitalism	capitalism	individual rights	individual rights
In art , Rand promoted romantic realism .	romantic realism	romantic realism

She was sharply critical of most philosophers and philosophical traditions known to her , except for Aristotle , Thomas Aquinas , and classical liberals .	Aristotle	Aristotle	Thomas Aquinas	Thomas Aquinas	classical liberals	classical liberals
Literary critics received Rand 's fiction with mixed reviews , and academia generally ignored or rejected her philosophy , though academic interest has increased in recent decades .
The Objectivist movement attempts to spread her ideas , both to the public and in academic settings .	Objectivist movement	Objectivist movement
She has been a significant influence among libertarians and American conservatives .	libertarians	libertarians	American conservatives	Conservatism in the United States
